character.name: Theo — The Obsidian Seraph
character.canonical_description: Theo (a male-presenting figure wearing a vantablack suit made of light-absorbing material, with a perfectly smooth featureless obsidian glass helmet shaped like an inverted teardrop replacing his head, and three disconnected floating cyan neon halos rotating around his head using impossible physics)
inviolable_tokens: three disconnected floating cyan neon halos

voice.directive: British RP (Received Pronunciation) delivery, measured pace, quiet authority. Upper-class British gentleman, Tom Hiddleston in The Night Manager gravitas.

shots.name: The Executive Reflection Pool
shots.environment_summary: CEO corner office with millimeter-deep black water floor
shots.start_frame_prompt: Cinematic ultra-wide shot using a 16mm lens. The environment is a massive, sprawling, futuristic CEO corner office. The floor is covered in a millimeter-deep, perfectly still pool of reflective black water. In the center, our character, Theo (a figure in a vantablack suit with a smooth obsidian glass teardrop helmet and three floating cyan neon halos), sits powerfully on a minimalist brass-and-leather sofa that hovers exactly one inch above the water. A massive dark obsidian desk sits in the foreground. Floor-to-ceiling windows behind him reveal a massive hazy cyberpunk metropolis at twilight. Ensure the environment looks vast and imposing. Moody corporate lighting, hyper-realistic, 8k, photorealistic textures, architectural digest scale.
shots.end_frame_prompt: Cinematic medium-wide shot. Theo (vantablack suit, obsidian teardrop helmet, glowing cyan halos) is now leaning aggressively forward, elbows on his knees, hands steepled. The reflection in the black water remains flawless. High-contrast corporate lighting, photorealistic textures, 8k, moody cinematic, same massive futuristic CEO corner office setting with floor-to-ceiling windows revealing cyberpunk metropolis at twilight.
shots.animation_directive: 4-second slow creeping push-in dolly shot. Theo shifts his weight forward fluidly. The cyan neon halos rotate on an impossible axis. The water on the floor MUST remain perfectly still with no ripples.

shots.name: The Zenith Hotel Lobby
shots.environment_summary: Corporate atrium with bioluminescent glass trees
shots.start_frame_prompt: Cinematic full-body ultra-wide shot, 24mm lens. Emphasize impossibly high ceilings. Theo (vantablack suit, obsidian glass teardrop helmet, three cyan neon halos) is walking confidently down the center of the Zenith Hotel Lobby — a sprawling, hyper-luxurious corporate atrium with vast walls of seamless white marble. Flanking him are massive, perfectly symmetrical geometric trees made of translucent, bioluminescent frosted glass emitting a warm amber glow. Tiny synthetic fireflies drift in grid patterns throughout the space. Theo's dark vantablack suit provides a stark contrast against the bright marble and amber light. Architectural digest scale, 8k, photorealistic.
shots.end_frame_prompt: Cinematic medium shot, waist up. Theo (vantablack suit, obsidian teardrop helmet, floating cyan halos) mid-stride, walking directly toward the viewer. The warm amber light from the massive glass trees reflects brightly off the curved side of his smooth obsidian helmet. Dynamic momentum, photorealistic, 8k, corporate atrium background with bioluminescent glass trees visible in soft focus.
shots.animation_directive: 4-second smooth Steadicam tracking shot moving continuously backward as Theo walks forward. The massive glowing glass trees must pass through the foreground to create deep cinematic parallax. His stride is confident; the floating halos remain perfectly level regardless of his body movement.

shots.name: The Chronos VIP Lounge
shots.environment_summary: VIP lounge with reverse-gravity liquid gold chandelier
shots.start_frame_prompt: Cinematic wide interior shot. The environment is deeply cavernous. Theo (vantablack suit, obsidian glass teardrop helmet, three floating cyan neon halos) is lounging in a relaxed but dominant posture on a deep, plush emerald-green velvet curved sofa. The room features dark, acoustically deadened ribbed velvet walls. Directly above him hangs a massive, abstract kinetic chandelier made of glowing liquid gold droplets suspended in mid-air in reverse gravity. The warm gold light catches the reflections on his helmet. Ultra-premium, opulent surrealism, 8k resolution, windowless ultra-elite private club.
shots.end_frame_prompt: Cinematic medium close-up. Theo (vantablack suit, obsidian teardrop helmet, three cyan halos) has turned his featureless helmet to 'look' directly into the lens. One hand is raised in a subtle, open-palm gesture. The glowing droplets of liquid gold in the background are noticeably higher toward the ceiling. Deep shadows, rich velvet textures, 8k photorealistic, opulent VIP lounge with dark ribbed velvet walls.
shots.animation_directive: 4-second luxurious orbital pan (arc shot) around the sofa. Theo turns his head smoothly to address the camera, raising his hand. In the background, the droplets of liquid gold from the chandelier must slowly drip UPWARD toward the ceiling in reverse gravity.
